rules.note: Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 without extended context compact at the 200K boundary (with [1m] they use the 1M rule)
rules.note_zh: Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 未开扩展上下文时在 200K 边界压缩(带 [1m] 时按 1M 规则)

rules.note: models with a native 1M window compact at about 967K tokens by default
rules.note_zh: 原生 1M 窗口的模型默认在约 967K token 时压缩

claude-code.otherwise_note: other models compact when the conversation reaches the model's context limit
claude-code.caveats: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 makes 1M models compact at 200K; cloud sessions compact as they approach the limit; unrecognized model IDs assume 200K.
claude-code.otherwise_note_zh: 其他模型在对话达到模型上下文上限时压缩

codex.note: with model_auto_compact_token_limit unset, the limit is 90% of the resolved context window; a configured value is clamped to that 90%
codex.note_zh: 未设置 model_auto_compact_token_limit 时,上限为上下文窗口的 90%;设置的值也会被截到这 90%

dsh.note: dsh-compaction-basic compacts at min(80% of the window, window - reserved output (256k) - headroom (65,536)): about 678k on a 1,000,000 window, 727k on 1,048,576
dsh.note_zh: dsh-compaction-basic 在「窗口×80%」与「窗口 − 预留输出(256k) − 余量(65,536)」中较小者处压缩:100 万窗口约 678k,1,048,576 窗口约 727k
